about.title: Head Track & Field Coach
about.bio: From first-time track athletes to competitive sprinters, jumpers, and throwers, I develop the technical foundations and athletic qualities that lead to personal records. Every athlete I work with trains smarter, moves more efficiently, and competes with purpose.

hero.headline: Faster. Stronger. Further.
hero.subline: Private track and field coaching — sprint mechanics, event development, and recruiting prep for athletes chasing personal records.

services.title: Sprint & Distance Training
services.description: Mechanics-first sessions for sprinters (100m–400m) and distance runners — technique, race cadence, and speed development.

services.title: Field Events (Jumps & Throws)
services.description: Long jump, high jump, triple jump, shot put, and discus — technical progressions built for safe improvement and measurable gains.

services.title: Race Strategy & Recruiting
services.description: Pacing plans, championship race strategy, and recruiting guidance for athletes targeting college track programs.

testimonials.quote: My son went from a backup sprinter to the team's #1 in the 100m in one season. The mechanics work was something his school coaches just couldn't provide.
testimonials.name: Marcus J.

testimonials.quote: I added almost two feet to my long jump in one off-season. The technical breakdown of my approach and takeoff made everything click.
testimonials.name: Jordan A.

success_stories.name: Isaiah W.
success_stories.story: Isaiah had elite speed but poor mechanics that were holding back his times. We spent one off-season breaking down his start, drive phase, and top-end form.
success_stories.result: Personal Record 10.8 · Regional Champion · D1 Offer

faq.question: What events do you train?
faq.answer: Sprints (100m–400m), distance (800m–mile), hurdles, long jump, triple jump, high jump, shot put, and discus. Pole vault by arrangement.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at local tracks and athletic facilities. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: Sessions run 60–75 minutes depending on event and training phase.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Sport-appropriate footwear (track spikes if available), athletic clothing, and water. Throwing implements and jump equipment are provided.

faq.question: Can you help with college recruiting?
faq.answer: Yes — I guide athletes on standards for different division levels, event selection strategy, and building a recruiting profile.
